source_block.parva: Bhishma Parva · Bhagavad Gita · Kurukshetra opens · Arjuna’s despair · Krishna’s teaching · Vishvarupa · resolve · conches
source_block.divergence: BORI CE / Debroy place the Bhagavad Gita dialogue at the opening of Bhishma Parva (Arjuna’s despondency, teaching of the eternal self / karma-yoga, the cosmic form, Arjuna’s resolve, sounding of conches). Ganguli’s vulgate English maps the same chariot beats (Sanjaya’s report). Gita Press Gorakhpur prints the Gita text under Bhishma with the same arc. Beats agree: armies → chariot between ranks → Gandiva slips → counsel → dharma teaching → Vishvarupa → resolve → conches → closing light. Exact śloka numbering varies by recension; this episode keeps the sacred teaching without gore battle focus.
source_block.chosen: Gita Press Gorakhpur + BORI/Debroy for the Gita beat map. Ganguli for English chariot / teaching wording.
source_block.notes: Not TV. Comic-mythology only. Arjuna = gold crown, dark mustache, cream-white dhoti, quiver, Gandiva. Krishna = yellow pitambar, peacock optional, garland, charioteer reins — never flute-primary, never bow. Vishvarupa = tasteful comic radiance, not horror CGI. Never attach Ep01 plate-wide-gold as Imagine ref. No Drona / white-bearded sage unless cast_present.
